---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

career_home_runs <- Batting |>
	group_by(playerID) |>
	summarize(
		career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
		first_season = min(yearID),
		last_season = max(yearID),
		.groups = "drop"
	) |>
	arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
	slice_head(n = 15) |>
	left_join(
		People |>
			select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
		by = "playerID"
	) |>
	mutate(
		player = str_c(nameFirst, nameLast, sep = " "),
		season_span = str_c(first_season, last_season, sep = " to "),
		era_status = if_else(
			last_season >= 1994 & first_season <= 2009,
			"Career overlapped steroid era",
			"Career outside steroid era"
		)
	) |>
	select(player, career_home_runs, season_span, era_status)

ggplot(
	career_home_runs,
	aes(
		x = career_home_runs,
		y = fct_reorder(player, career_home_runs),
		fill = era_status
	)
) +
	geom_col() +
	scale_fill_manual(
		values = c(
			"Career overlapped steroid era" = "#d95f02",
			"Career outside steroid era" = "gray50"
		)
	) +
	labs(
		title = "Career home run leaders by steroid-era overlap",
		x = "Career home runs",
		y = "Player",
		fill = "Steroid-era overlap",
		caption = "Source: Lahman database"
	)

bonds_by_season <- Batting |>
	filter(playerID == "bondsha01") |>
	group_by(yearID) |>
	summarize(
		home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
		.groups = "drop"
	)

ggplot(bonds_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
	geom_col(fill = "#d95f02") +
	labs(
		title = "Barry Bonds: home runs by season",
		x = "Season",
		y = "Home runs"
	)
```
